brief:
Israeli authorities are seeking to jail Palestinian student Mahdi Tounsi without trial following his arrest at his dormitory, The Guardian reported. Tounsi appeared with visible bruising after police interrogation focused on his work with Israeli-Palestinian organisations.

Israeli professors, students and rights activists have called for his immediate release. Tounsi's detention marks a flashpoint over Palestinian activism within Israeli academic institutions.
